blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Field errors are conveyed by a red border only, with no text) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed, since the red border already shows where the problem
is. No message text is added, to keep the form compact.
findings.recommendation: A screen reader user who tabs out of the postcode field with `ABC` hears nothing, and on returning to it hears only its label: the red border is not exposed to assistive technology, and with the top error list removed there is no text anywhere saying the field is invalid or why; colour-blind and low-vision users get only a hue change. This fails WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color, 3.3.1 Error Identification and 3.3.3 Error Suggestion. Add a text message next to each invalid field, associate it with `aria-describedby`, set `aria-invalid="true"` on the field (4.1.2 Name, Role, Value), and do not rely on colour alone (an icon or the message itself). Update the spec's requirement and scenarios ("the field's border turns red", "the border returns to grey") to require the message and its association, and the proposal's "invalid fields are shown in red" and task 1.2 to match.
findings.title: Field errors are conveyed by a red border only, with no text

findings.evidence: - The error list at the top of the form is removed.
findings.recommendation: Validation runs only on `blur`, so a keyboard or screen reader user who submits without visiting a required field, or who submits right after typing in the last field, gets no error on submit: the plan defines no submit behaviour, no summary remains and focus is not moved, so the user presses Enter on the submit button and nothing is announced (WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification, 2.4.3 Focus Order, 4.1.3 Status Messages). Specify that submit validates every field and moves focus to the first invalid field (or to an error summary linking to the fields), and add a scenario for it in `specs/checkout-validation/spec.md`.
findings.title: Removing the error list leaves submit with no error identification or focus move
